name: memory_v1_synthetic_project_history
description: Entirely fabricated project events. No TinyFund conversations or personal data.

events.text: Project Falcon chose SkyStore for logs because SkyStore offered free storage.
Project Falcon meeting was moved from Friday to Sunday because the train was delayed.
Project Falcon observed that SkyStore suspends idle log databases after seven days.
Project Falcon replaced SkyStore with RiverDB for current logs because idle database suspension was unacceptable. RiverDB is now the chosen provider.
During lunch an analyst bought an orange notebook and watched the rain.
Project Falcon must preserve original audit evidence for all deployment decisions, including rejected options.
The monthly budget ceiling for Project Falcon was initially five dollars, approved by the owner.
After a budget review, the current Project Falcon monthly budget ceiling changed from five dollars to four dollars.
Analyst Mara proposed switching Project Falcon to CloudNest; the proposal was rejected due to unreliable exports.
The experimental Atlas service uses CloudNest for illustrations and has no connection with Falcon logs.
